szoveg_eredeti:
Together with the UK Government, we’ve made PlanAssist: a tool built with Gemini that helps planning officers review applications faster. 🏡

Assessing applications for things like loft conversions, extensions, and conservatories takes up a significant amount of planning officer time, thus delaying building approvals.

PlanAssist works alongside officers to review building documents, check local policies, and draft initial reports for human approval. This clears administrative hurdles so officers can focus on more complex cases.

During early pilots in three councils, the tool has shown it can cut the average time needed to assess an application by up to 58%. It brought the time spent per assessment down to under 30 minutes, and officers accepted over 70% of its recommendations without needing to make changes.

The tool is now being made available to 12 more councils. 🏗️ 

By easing the administrative workload, we hope to safely speed up decisions for homeowners and support the development of future housing across the country.

Read the details → https://goo.gle/48sMcqk
